product_metadata.title: GoJars Hexagon Glass Jars 4oz Premium Food-grade. Mini Jars With Lids For Gifts, Wedding Favors, Honey, Jams And More. (12, 4oz)
features: Elegant Glass Jars: They're stylish, practical & versatile for any event, occassion, or DIY activity you want to try. These hexagon glass jars are suitable as honey jars, canning jars & even containers for homemade body scrubs, body butters & more! GoJars small jars that stack easily with all other sizes too for a clean pantry & kitchen.

Reliable & Functional: Our 4 oz glass jars with lids are easy to clean, seal well (when tightened form an air-tight seal), & can be boiled for making homemade goodies. The lids are made of metal, while the glass jar body is microwave, fridge & dishwasher safe.

Crystal Clear Glass: We use a thick & durable glass for all of our mini jars, ensuring your home's safety, they're all food safe & BPA Free. They make perfect little party favors as honey jars for weddings, or treats for a winnie the pooh baby shower. You can even decorate the outside since the smooth flat glass offers an easy way to personalize the jars.

Crafted for your Home: enjoy mixing & matching our jars to create amazing sets of spice jars, sugar scrub tubs, lotions or essential oil diffusers. From 1.5oz glass jars to 6oz glass jars, our selection of mini jars can complement any kitchen or party for a cozier feel. Pair ceramic mugs with our honey jars in bulk for an awesome tea & honey jar party favor.

Go Jars Go! Beyond food & self care kits, you can also make mini herb gardens with our medium sized glass jars, or hanging succulent pots (don't forget to make a drainage hole). There's lots to do, in case you have further feedback, we'd love to hear what you've done with the jars! Sincerely, the GoJars team.
